intro.text: Frozen Crystal Compound drops from Cascading Molokh, Novictum Blight and Reprogrammed Mezzorash in Alappaa.
While all the Compounds looks almost the same there are really several types that drop. Easiest way to check which one dropped is to open the tradeskill window and check the result.

steps.text: Note: Depending on what Compound you found, you will end up with a different Jewel (or Robe)
